bugs.error_message: zellij run floating pane appears and closes immediately — no TUI visible, ZSH hangs on FIFO read
bugs.root_cause: When inZellij=true, code used process.stdin for Ink instead of /dev/tty. zellij run does not wire process.stdin to the pane PTY, so stdin.isTTY was false, causing Ink to throw raw mode error on mount and exit immediately.
bugs.fix: Always open /dev/tty (with .catch(() => null) fallback) for Ink stdin/stdout, regardless of inZellij. /dev/tty always refers to the controlling terminal which IS the pane PTY in a zellij run context.

bugs.root_cause: Claude returns JSON wrapped in  fence despite prompt instructions. parseCandidates called JSON.parse on fenced text which failed, triggering prose fallback that used the entire fenced string as a command.
bugs.fix: Added stripCodeFence() to extract the JSON array from inside the fence before JSON.parse.
